# Statistics Portfolio

## About
Valdinar Pires
Student at the University of Campinas (UNICAMP), with an interest in statistical analysis, data visualization, and statistical modeling.

This portfolio brings together projects developed throughout my academic training, with an emphasis on applying statistical concepts to real-world and historical datasets.

## Projects

The projects presented here explore different statistical methods and approaches, combining theoretical foundations with practical analysis in R and other data-related tools.

### Current projects

* **Semmelweis Handwashing Study**
  Analysis of historical data from the Vienna General Hospital, investigating the relationship between handwashing and maternal mortality.

More projects will be added as my academic portfolio develops.


## Tools

The main tools used across the projects include:

* R
* Quarto
* Git and GitHub

Additional tools and programming languages will be incorporated as the portfolio expands.
